name: EM Carry-to-Vol Ranking: BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, IDR
description: Ranks BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, and IDR by their carry-to-vol ratio (interest rate differential divided by realized FX volatility). Carry = EM overnight rate minus US Fed Funds rate (FRED monthly series, ffill'd to daily). Vol = 63-day annualized realized FX volatility. Shows which currency offers the best risk-adjusted carry and whether the top-ranked currency (highest carry-to-vol) outperforms the others over the subsequent 63 trading days.
source:
# =============================================================================
# EM CARRY-TO-VOL RANKING: BRL, MXN, ZAR, TRY, IDR
# =============================================================================
# Carry = EM overnight rate - US Fed Funds rate (FRED, monthly → ffill daily)
# Vol   = 63-day annualized realized FX volatility on USDXXX close price
# Ratio = carry (decimal) / vol (decimal) — risk-adjusted carry
# FX convention: USDBRL/USDMXN/USDZAR/USDTRY/USDIDR = USD per EM unit
#   -> Falling pair = EM currency strengthening
#   -> Invert FX return so positive = EM appreciation vs USD
# Rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol among 5 currencies
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close_fx = src.c
bar_idx = index()

# =============================================================================
# INTEREST RATES (FRED)
# Monthly series → ffill to daily
# All rates in % (e.g., 13.5 = 13.5% annualized)
# =============================================================================

# US Federal Funds Effective Rate (daily, no ffill needed but apply for safety)
usd_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='DFF')()
usd_rate = ffill(usd_rate_raw.result)

# Brazil overnight interbank rate (monthly)
brl_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01BRM156N')()
brl_rate = ffill(brl_rate_raw.result)

# Mexico overnight interbank rate (monthly)
mxn_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01MXM156N')()
mxn_rate = ffill(mxn_rate_raw.result)

# South Africa overnight interbank rate (monthly)
zar_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01ZAM156N')()
zar_rate = ffill(zar_rate_raw.result)

# Turkey overnight interbank rate (monthly)
try_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01TRM156N')()
try_rate = ffill(try_rate_raw.result)

# Indonesia overnight interbank rate (monthly)
idr_rate_raw = economic_indicators(series_id='IRSTCI01IDM156N')()
idr_rate = ffill(idr_rate_raw.result)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY = EM RATE - USD RATE (converted to decimal)
# FRED rates are in % → divide by 100 for decimal
# =============================================================================

# Each asset context uses its own EM rate via conditional_select
# is_asset_ref identifies which FX pair is running in this context
is_brl = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDBRL')()
is_mxn = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDMXN')()
is_zar = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDZAR')()
is_try = is_asset_ref(ticker='USDTRY')()

em_rate_pct = conditional_select(is_brl, brl_rate, is_mxn, mxn_rate, is_zar, zar_rate, is_try, try_rate, idr_rate)
carry_decimal = (em_rate_pct - usd_rate) / 100.0

# =============================================================================
# REALIZED FX VOLATILITY (63-day annualized)
# volatility() expects price levels, outputs annualized decimal (e.g., 0.15 = 15%)
# =============================================================================

fx_vol = volatility(period=63)(close_fx)

# =============================================================================
# CARRY-TO-VOL RATIO
# Both carry_decimal and fx_vol are in decimal → ratio is dimensionless
# Guard: only compute when vol is valid and positive
# =============================================================================

carry_to_vol = where(is_valid(fx_vol) and fx_vol > 0.001, carry_decimal / fx_vol)

# =============================================================================
# CROSS-SECTIONAL RANK (rank 1 = highest carry-to-vol = best risk-adjusted carry)
# =============================================================================

ctv_rank = cs_rank(ascending=False)(carry_to_vol)

# Is this asset currently ranked #1 (top carry-to-vol)?
is_top_ranked = is_valid(ctv_rank) and (ctv_rank == 1.0)

# Detect when this asset BECOMES rank 1 (crossover event)
was_top_ranked = is_top_ranked >> 1
became_top = is_top_ranked and not was_top_ranked

# =============================================================================
# FORWARD FX RETURN (63-day ahead, inverted: positive = EM appreciation)
# Use << operator (lead) — forward price level, then compute return
# Invert because USDBRL falling = BRL strengthening
# =============================================================================

close_fx_fwd63 = close_fx << 63
fx_fwd_ret_raw = (close_fx_fwd63 - close_fx) / close_fx
fx_fwd_ret = -1.0 * fx_fwd_ret_raw

# Forward return when this asset is top-ranked
top_fwd_ret = where(is_top_ranked, fx_fwd_ret)

# Forward return when NOT top-ranked (rank 2 or 3)
not_top_fwd_ret = where(not is_top_ranked and is_valid(ctv_rank), fx_fwd_ret)

# =============================================================================
# DASHBOARD
# =============================================================================

# --- CHART 1: Carry-to-Vol Ratio Over Time (context: which currency leads?) ---
cs_lines(
    title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio: Which EM Currency Has Best Risk-Adjusted Carry?',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    y_axis_label='Carry / Realized Vol',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    colors=[Color.Blue, Color.Orange, Color.Teal, Color.Red, Color.Cyan],
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=0
)(bar_idx, carry_to_vol)

# --- CHART 2: Current Carry-to-Vol Snapshot (punchline: who leads right now?) ---
cs_bars(
    title='Current Carry-to-Vol Ranking (Higher = Better Risk-Adjusted Carry)',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    sort_by_value=SortByValue.Descending,
    data_labels=True,
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=1
)(carry_to_vol)

# --- SUMMARY TABLE: Carry, Vol, Ratio, and Forward Return by Rank ---
cs_summary_table(
    title='EM Carry-to-Vol: Carry, Vol, Ratio & 63-Day Forward FX Return',
    category='EM Carry-to-Vol',
    agg=AggregationType.Last,
    schema=TableReportSchema(
        title='EM Carry-to-Vol Summary',
        include_timestamp=False,
        columns=[
            ColumnSpec(title='EM Rate (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry vs USD (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='63d Realized Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Rank (1=Best)', type=CardRenderType.IntegerFormat, dp=0, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Fwd 63d Return (Top Rank)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean),
            ColumnSpec(title='Avg Fwd 63d Return (Not Top)', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2, grid_agg=AggregationType.Mean)
        ]
    ),
    order=2
)(em_rate_pct, carry_decimal * 100.0, fx_vol, carry_to_vol, ctv_rank, top_fwd_ret, not_top_fwd_ret)

# =============================================================================
# EVENT MARKERS: When a currency becomes the top carry-to-vol pick
# =============================================================================

event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New Top Carry-to-Vol Pick',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(type=CardRenderType.BooleanFormat, table_is_filter=True),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Hero, title='Carry-to-Vol Ratio', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle, title='Carry vs USD (%)', type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='63d Realized Vol', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=1),
            ColumnSpec(card_slot=CardSlot.Details, title='63d Fwd FX Return', type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat, dp=2)
        ]
    )
)(became_top, carry_to_vol, carry_decimal * 100.0, fx_vol, fx_fwd_ret)
